mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.user_id, c.store_id, c.title, c.content, c.capacity, c.view_count, c.meeting_at, c.status, c.auto_accept, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM coeat c JOIN root r ON c.id = r.id AND r.type = 'COEAT' AND ORDER BY r.created_at DESC

SELECT c.id, c.user_id, c.store_id, c.title, c.content, c.capacity, c.view_count, c.meeting_at, c.status, c.auto_accept, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM coeat c JOIN root r ON c.id = r.id AND r.type = 'COEAT' AND WHERE c.store_id = #{storeId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) AS openCount FROM coeat WHERE status = 'OPEN' AND meeting_at >= NOW() AND store_id = #{storeId}

SELECT c.id, c.user_id, c.store_id, c.title, c.content, c.capacity, c.view_count, c.meeting_at, c.status, c.auto_accept, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM coeat c JOIN root r ON c.id = r.id AND r.type = 'COEAT' AND WHERE c.id = #{coeatId}
SELECT capacity FROM coeat WHERE id = #{coeatId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM coeat c JOIN root r ON c.id = r.id AND r.type = 'COEAT' AND WHERE c.id = #{coeatId} )
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM coeat c JOIN root r ON c.id = r.id AND r.type = 'COEAT' AND WHERE c.id = #{coeatId} AND c.status = 'OPEN' )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO coeat (id, user_id, store_id, title, content, capacity, meeting_at, auto_accept) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{storeId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{capacity}, #{meetingAt}, #{autoAccept})
mapper.update: UPDATE coeat c JOIN root r ON c.id = r.id AND r.type = 'COEAT' AND SET c.store_id = #{coeat.storeId}, c.title = #{coeat.title}, c.content = #{coeat.content}, c.capacity = #{coeat.capacity}, c.meeting_at = #{coeat.meetingAt}, c.auto_accept = #{coeat.autoAccept}, r.updated_at = NOW() WHERE c.id = #{coeatId} AND c.user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE coeat c JOIN root r ON c.id = r.id AND r.type = 'COEAT' AND SET r.deleted_at = NOW() WHERE c.id = #{coeatId} AND c.user_id = #{userId}
